entries.text: A TPC-H database that a refresh run (RF1 or RF2) modified is no longer reused by a later run, whatever its row counts. The refresh functions now record that they ran against the database; the next run recreates it when it lives in the BenchBox output directory and refuses with the reason otherwise.

compare no longer refuses a current MCP result that recorded neither a compression setting nor platform options. Results now record an execution.config_capture marker, so compare separates MCP results from before MCP and CLI runs shared defaults, which stay refused, from current ones without inferring it from the configuration.

Result bundles (schema 2.5) can record the vendor plan tier, preview features, vendor permission, vendor notice and self-run attestation in the provenance block. benchbox run takes --plan-tier and --preview-feature, and the bundle validator and benchbox submit refuse free-tier, trial and preview results without the vendor permission the vendor terms require. Schema 2.4 and older bundles still load.
